framework: WPA AI Authority, Rights & Remedies Framework

added_directives.name: Silent Speech Consent & Command Gate
added_directives.rule: Uncertain silent-speech inference defaults to no command and no irreversible action.

added_directives.name: Facial and Biosignal Inference Minimality
added_directives.rule: Biosignal inferences require separate purpose, retention and remedy controls.

added_directives.name: Assistive-Surveillance Boundary
added_directives.rule: Assistive silent-speech use must not become covert emotion, intent or health surveillance.

signature_rule_en: The face may become an interface; it must not become an involuntary mandate. Silent expression is not silent consent.
signature_rule_mk: Лицето може да стане интерфејс; не смее да стане неволен мандат. Тивкиот израз не е тивка согласност.
